in_hebrew.name: Ilarrold
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Rule by God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ilarrold הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German elements ila (God) and hrod (rule or fame). The name Ilarrold means 'Rule by God' or 'God's rule'.

in_greek.name: Ilarrold
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Rule by God
in_greek.long_meaning: Ilarrold είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old German elements ila (God) and hrod (rule or fame). The name Ilarrold means 'Rule by God' or 'God's rule'.

in_latin.name: Ilarrold
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Rule by God
in_latin.long_meaning: Ilarrold est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old German elements ila (God) and hrod (rule or fame). The name Ilarrold means 'Rule by God' or 'God's rule'.
